mechanism: Torsemide causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increases QT prolongation risk, and atazanavir also prolongs QT interval; additionally, atazanavir may inhibit renal tubular secretion of torsemide affecting its clearance.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, assess QTc interval baseline and periodically, consider alternative diuretic if possible, and supplement potassium/magnesium as needed.
